panels.label: 佩戴展示
panels.copy_purpose: 自然佩戴场景，突出正确佩戴位置与商品本体
panels.style_reference_en: Translate Image1 panel 1's elegant afternoon-tea interaction into the uploaded jewelry's correct wearing location: intimate lifestyle crop, graceful cup gesture, warm cream table setting, and soft window light. Preserve the product authority, never the reference jewelry.
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact product naturally and correctly worn by one adult model seated at an elegant afternoon-tea table, with one hand naturally holding a teacup below face level so the jewelry remains unobstructed.
panels.backdrop_en: Warm refined ivory tearoom interior, understated cream clothing, one porcelain cup and sparse pale flowers kept away from the jewelry.
panels.composition_en: Use an upper-torso three-quarter portrait with the complete face naturally visible, the correct wearing location prominent, and a graceful live hand gesture; place the model on the right two-thirds and keep calm copy space at left.
panels.lighting_en: Warm side-window light, natural skin, controlled highlights on metal, stones, and surface details.

panels.label: 结构全貌
panels.copy_purpose: 完整商品中突出可观察的结构、镶嵌、轮廓与表面细节
panels.style_reference_en: Translate Image1 panel 2's pale ivory high-angle technical editorial, airy botanical negative space, large product scale, crisp construction emphasis, and clean catalog light; omit its jewelry and inset graphics.
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact complete item in a detail-led product photograph, using camera angle and light to document its most distinctive construction and surface details without cropping any part.
panels.backdrop_en: Pale warm marble with sparse translucent cream accents at the outer corners.
panels.composition_en: Keep the complete item and its full outer silhouette inside frame with breathing room; make the defining feature pin-sharp in the upper-middle and keep the lower area quiet.
panels.lighting_en: Soft raking daylight, crisp micro-contrast, realistic restrained highlights.

panels.label: 氛围静物
panels.copy_purpose: 暖调静物广告，突出商品质感和完整结构
panels.style_reference_en: Adapt Image1 panel 3's amber afternoon still life, book-and-glass depth layers, long directional shadows, diagonal visual rhythm, and nostalgic editorial warmth.
panels.scene_prompt_en: Place the exact complete product in an intimate premium afternoon still life using an arrangement appropriate to its structure.
panels.backdrop_en: Warm walnut surface, edge of an open vintage book, one clear stemmed glass; sparse and believable.
panels.composition_en: Arrange the product clearly across the lower half and keep the upper-right clean.
panels.lighting_en: Amber late-afternoon window light with controlled product highlights.

panels.label: 礼赠展示
panels.copy_purpose: 无品牌礼盒或合适支撑上的完整礼赠陈列
panels.style_reference_en: Translate Image1 panel 4's luminous gift presentation: an open unbranded jewelry box, ivory textile folds, restrained champagne ribbon, ceremonial premium mood, and generous editorial negative space. Preserve only this display grammar, never its jewelry.
panels.scene_prompt_en: Present the exact product in one correctly scaled open premium unbranded jewelry box appropriate to its category, with every source-evidenced component unobstructed.
panels.backdrop_en: Flowing ivory satin around an open matte-ivory box, with one restrained champagne ribbon confined to the far edge.
panels.composition_en: Use a high three-quarter gift-tableau view: box and complete product centered in the lower-right two-thirds, with a clean upper-left margin; remain visibly distinct from panel 2 through the open box, textile depth, and wider ceremonial framing.
panels.lighting_en: Soft luminous daylight with warm ivory bounce, controlled shadows, and realistic restrained highlights.

panels.label: 镜面佩戴
panels.copy_purpose: 模特自然佩戴及物理一致的镜面生活方式展示
panels.style_reference_en: Translate Image1 panel 5's warm dressing-room mirror portrait: elegant side profile, complete natural face, calm hand at collarbone, narrow champagne mirror divider, and intimate medium-wide editorial mood. Reflection geometry is completed deterministically.
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a source plate for deterministic mirror composition: exactly one adult model correctly wearing the exact product, in left-facing side profile, and no reflection or second person.
panels.backdrop_en: Refined warm ivory dressing interior. Keep the left half empty and visually continuous for deterministic reflection insertion; place the sole real model entirely in the right half.
panels.composition_en: Use two vertical zones separated by a broad calm center aisle. In the right zone show the complete head, face, neck, shoulders, upper torso, and visible hand of one left-facing side-profile model. Keep the tip of the nose to the right of 60% image width and the hand below the chin at the collarbone, never covering face or jewelry. Do not draw a mirror, frame, reflection, or second person; the workflow adds one physically exact reflection.
panels.lighting_en: Warm side-window light with believable reflection, perspective, and falloff.
